_comment: Look of the aggro meter (the threat box on the left). Restart the server after editing; it's sent to the game when you log in, no rebuild needed. Colours are #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (AA = opacity, 00 see-through to FF solid). x and y move the box from the middle of the left edge (x: right, y: up; negative y goes down), in screen units of a 1920x1080 screen.
